title: PulseDAO
tagline: DAO rewarding users and providing workshops (GiveAway rewards)
description: The project aim to reward users based on their activeness , using a GiveAway process, and taking advantage of ERC721 NFT to make some streams on it. Our DAO aim to reward their members based on their activeness by providing the possibility to the members to be accountable if they win the NFT from the giveAway.
how_its_made: We have used Superfluid on this project to create a CashFlow stream. We managed to upgrade to SuperToken MaticX and create a stream of flows in the BudgetNFT Contract Address. Our DAO aim to reward their members based on their activeness by providing the possibility to the members to be accountable if they win the NFT from the giveAway.
